stages: Production preload, main Git service, real index/worktree comparison
Continuous diff, file-tree navigation, split layout and full-context expansion
Binary, oversized, empty and permission metadata stay separate from source
Staged, commit, root commit, branch choice, merge base and reference-error recovery
External file and index changes refresh the active snapshot
Delayed project A response cannot overwrite project B
Hidden tab/drawer and simulated page frame suspension release reads and workers
Non-repository initialization and explicit opened-project authorization
Native hunk and file actions change the real index and preserve the working copy
Discard confirms before writing, preserves extra unstaged edits, and offers durable recovery
Overlapping patches, foreign index locks and edits made during confirmation preserve all changes
Batch stage, unstage and discard work with binary additions; recovery history survives reload
Commit dialog shows real staged paths and message; commit-only preserves the local Git result
Without an upstream, the dialog accepts an explicit remote and branch and completes commit plus push
Push-only handles an already configured upstream without requiring a commit message
An alternate remote branch receives current HEAD even when a stale local branch has the same name
Commit hook rejection is classified in the dialog and does not create a commit
Non-fast-forward push rejection keeps the local commit and exposes the partial result
An in-flight commit can be cancelled from the confirmation dialog and leaves the index unchanged
Closing during preparation cancels a late confirmation token without reopening the dialog or writing Git
Cancelling a post-commit hook retains HEAD and reports the completed local commit
A subproject commit refuses staged changes outside its preview and retains the complete index
A settled turn records only its own immutable file changes and marks unfinished commands
Later disk changes enter live Git without rewriting the recorded turn
A project without a recorded turn says so instead of showing current content
Collected snapshot objects are reported as expired, never as current content
A read-only review validates every finding against the frozen range and lists what it rejected
A failed review shows its reason and retries the same range
A running review can be cancelled and keeps its history entry
Findings jump to their line and a review kept for another range is marked stale
Review history survives a renderer reload
A line selection creates a comment bound to its snapshot, side, lines and exact snippet
A multi-line selection enters the conversation draft with its exact location and snippet
Comments resolve, reopen and stay out of the list until asked for
A file version change marks its comments outdated instead of moving them silently
Line comments stay scoped to their project and conversation and survive a reload
Renderer reload/window close cleanup and offline dark/English rendering
